verdict.rationale: Diagnosing silent GPU-to-CPU fallback is a fair question for a local LLM runner, so the axis applies. The pack only shows GPU offload configuration (`lms load --gpu=max|auto|0.0-1.0`), not any diagnostic output explaining why acceleration failed or fell back. Community reports point the other way: models failing to load with no error feedback, and no way to set CUDA acceleration before loading.
